description: Drill string experienced elevated resistance and became temporarily stuck.
cause: Increasing torque and declining rate of penetration in a mechanically unstable interval.
mitigation: Circulation, controlled WOB reduction, and reciprocation of the drill string.
outcome: Drilling resumed after controlled freeing operation.

description: Torque increased significantly while drilling through the interval.
cause: Increased formation resistance and poor hole-cleaning conditions.
mitigation: Adjusted WOB/RPM and improved circulation parameters.
outcome: Torque returned toward the normal operating range.
